messages.subject: Project Mosaic - report on title
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Our report on title is attached. In short: the title is good and marketable, the local search is in and clear, and we recommend you proceed to exchange and completion. Key numbers: price £21,750,000 (TOGC, no VAT); deposit on exchange £2,175,000; balance on completion approximately £19,020,081 plus SDLT of £1,077,000 and registration costs. WAULT 6.2 years to expiry; net initial yield c.6.28%.

We'd be grateful for board approval and your authority to exchange on 19 September with completion on 10 October.

Best
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
